claims: Starting with the 2026 season, Sunday Night Baseball has moved to NBC and Peacock, ending its long run on ESPN.
Sunday Night Baseball games air weekly on Sunday evenings.
Sunday Night Baseball games are broadcast on NBC.
Sunday Night Baseball games are streamed on Peacock Premium.
Sunday Night Baseball games are often simulcast on NBCSN.
The new era begins with the Cleveland Guardians vs. Seattle Mariners on March 29, 2026.
Peacock (Premium/Plus) streams all Sunday Night games.
Jason Benetti serves as the lead play-by-play announcer for NBC Sports.
Peacock streams an exclusive afternoon "Sunday Leadoff" game in addition to the night game.
March 29, 2026: Cleveland Guardians at Seattle Mariners (Peacock/NBCSN).
April 5, 2026: St. Louis Cardinals at Chicago Cubs (NBC/Peacock).
April 12, 2026: Cleveland Guardians at Atlanta Braves (NBC/Peacock).
April 19, 2026: Atlanta Braves at Philadelphia Phillies (Peacock).
